$comment: Passed to `claude -p ... --settings config/claude_hooks.json` by app/services/claude_code_agent.py. Registers scripts/claude_confirm_hook.py as a PreToolUse hook for every tool call — the script decides approve/block itself (see app/services/tools.is_dangerous), so the matcher intentionally covers all tools rather than a subset. Does NOT use `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` to locate the script: this deployment runs `claude -p` with cwd=desktop_root (the user's own workspace, e.g. G:\我的雲端硬碟\claude\LINE), so that variable does not point at this repo. It also broke on Windows regardless, because embedding the Chinese-containing GDrive path as literal text in this hook's shell command line gets mangled by the OS's non-UTF-8 codepage. Instead, `_subprocess_env` (claude_code_agent.py) sets CLAUDE_HOOKS_REPO_ROOT as a real env var (Unicode-safe, no shell text substitution), and the command below is a plain-ASCII `python -c` one-liner that reads it via `os.environ` and runs the hook script with `runpy.run_path` (this preserves `__file__` inside the hook so its own `_REPO_ROOT` computation still works).
